description:
LANDED 2f3605e28 (merged to wt/kdt13-boundaries 2026-08-31; two-round
adversarial review, final verdict MERGE with every quantitative claim
independently reproduced).

THE CHANGE: the transport-shape recursion cut moved from transient
scheduler state (pending-SCC queries at evaluation, resolved by a knot
lottery that stamped the winner's ty/demand on every group member) to a
STRUCTURAL FACT decided at recipe construction:
- static edges: cut iff same CallGraphComponent AND non-rising function id
  (kept edges strictly climb -> acyclic; same-function always cut);
- grounded ClosureCallReturn edges: cut iff the target statically reaches
  the owner (statically_reaches over StaticCallees; SCC equality is
  insufficient -- closure calls through parameters contribute no static
  edge, the round-1 BLOCKER, caught by the refuter with a base-green/
  HEAD-broken repro);
- a cut arm contributes no evidence; readable arms decide while their
  agreed form carries the position's whole analyzed type, else the
  type/demand contract (tuple_refined_demand for exact tuple types);
  carrier stays Absent (boxing is the lane's ValueRef REPR).
DELETED in the same motion: RecipeLayout::Recursive + anchor group
resolution, recursive_group_transport_layouts, finish_transport_shape_
group, transport-side pending_dependency_reaches/pending_recursive_group
(pull.rs group machinery stays for CallableConstruction = fz-kdt.96).
Second blocker half (builder-found): exact_direct_callable_layout's
component test stripped exact capture surfaces off self-threaded closures
-- replaced with precise capture-identity membership.

RESULTS: order-invariance BYTE-IDENTICAL under pending.reverse() on six
fixtures (base moved 50/432 canon lines); the 26 lane-below-analyzed-ty
positions (RED at base, incl. 5 in main/0) corrected -- permanent gate
compiler2_whole_value_lanes_stay_above_the_analyzed_ty; canon movement vs
d5d45a074: 172/50/92 lines, +44 decompositions gained, 1 lost (predicate
v9, proven forced-honest), ZERO carrier moves; pins 59/221/214 hold;
stdout byte-identical 6/6; three new closure_threaded_recursion* fixtures
green in all three paths (the plain one REPAIRS a pre-existing base
defect: interp call_closure-on-Int(0)); fresh gate on merged HEAD lib
1511/0, cli 23/0, matrix 425/0, clippy -D warnings, fmt clean.

REFUTED ALONG THE WAY (recorded, do not rebuild): boxed-Exact at the
pending cut (deadlock -- the knot WAS the cycle-breaking protocol);
per-member knot re-evaluation (livelock -- pending queries are transient
state mutated by the eval's own reads); the reviewed ticket's literal
"join Boxed like Exact" (collapses zero-lottery range_map); cut
contributes nothing (68 violations); cut ALL grounded edges (breaks
curried_add's one-authority exact carrier, fz-9i4.4.5); result-kind rule
and condensation-forward-only (both wedge/break currying).

CARRIED FORWARD: fz-kdt.97 (P1: the 13 net tail->continue conversions =
measured ~+22-26% deep-split runtime, 48.3->55.5-60.8s on 30k elems --
return/payload contract disagreement, NOT the closure edge); fz-kdt.98
(residual mutual-CPS hole: unconstructible across two campaigns, boxing
seam severs every attempt fact-derivedly; + statically_reaches
memoization rider); fz-kdt.96 (CallableConstruction facts lottery);
fz-kdt.99 (pre-existing interp-lane unreachable_control crash bycatch).
title: DONE: the transport recursion cut is a fact, not a race (2f3605e28; order-invariant canon, 26 lane-below-ty positions corrected)
